Citymaker.Park.bikePath.Tooltip: A wide cycle route through the park between two far-apart entrances, kept apart from the footpaths and crossing them square. Uses a bike path when one is installed, otherwise a wide path.
Citymaker.Park.bikeGap.Tooltip: How far the bike route keeps from footpaths running alongside it.
Citymaker.Park.bikeAsset.Tooltip: Automatic picks the two-way bike path, then a path with bike lanes, then a wide footpath.
Citymaker.Park.smallPaths.Tooltip: Narrow paths across the larger lawns, joining two main paths.
Citymaker.Park.trails.Tooltip: Informal trails winding through the planted belt along the park's edge, joined to the nearest path.
Citymaker.Park.trailAsset.Tooltip: Automatic picks a gravel or dirt path when one is installed, otherwise a footpath.
Citymaker.Park.desireLines.Tooltip: Desire lines: shortcuts people take where the paths make them walk around. Worn = trodden ground (terrain paint), paved = small paths.
Citymaker.Park.desireLayer.Tooltip: Ground texture for the worn shortcuts: 1 dry grass, 2 forest floor, 3 dirt, 4 sand on vanilla maps (other maps: the closest material).
Citymaker.Park.trailStyle.Tooltip: Path net: a real dirt/gravel path. Painted: trodden dirt painted into the ground (frayed, natural); people can walk it only when an invisible pedestrian path is available, otherwise it is just a look. Painting is permanent.
Citymaker.Paint.Issue.TrailVisualOnly: Painted trails are a look only: no invisible pedestrian path in this playset, so nobody walks them.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.BikeNeedsTwoEntranc: The bike route needs two bike entrances at least 40 m apart.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.NoBikeRoute: No room for a bike route through the park.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.FewerSmallPaths: Fewer small paths fit than asked for.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForTrails: No room for dirt trails along the edge.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.NoDesireLines: The paths are already direct: no shortcuts needed.
Citymaker.Feature.ground.Tooltip: Patches of dirt, mown grass, meadow, rocks, gravel or sand with soft, blended edges.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.NoBikeEntrances: The bike route is on, but there are no bike entrances. Place two bike entrances on the outline.
Citymaker.Entrance.Pedestrian.Tip: People walk in here. A thin path joins the park paths.
Citymaker.Entrance.Bike.Tip: Cyclists and pedestrians come in here. The bike route runs between bike entrances. Best facing a bike path or a road with bike lanes.
Citymaker.Entrance.Main.Tip: The grand entrance: a wide main walk and a gateway of planters and lamps. Best on a big road.
Citymaker.Entrance.Service.Tip: Maintenance access: a short service track to the paths. Best on a quiet street.
Citymaker.Entrance.Reason.Needs: Place at least one entrance on the outline. The faint markers show good spots.
